notes: Governor vote totals are listed-candidate totals in the official result PDFs; they exclude any unlisted write-ins and are not the statewide ballots-cast denominator.
Turnout is ballots cast divided by registered voters. Ballot totals differ from votes for listed governor candidates.
2025 governor votes divided by same-party 2024 presidential votes are aggregate ratios, not individual retention or turnout rates.
Higher Democratic vote growth is consistent with a turnout contribution, but aggregate totals cannot separate returning voters, new voters and switching or attribute polling error to turnout.

The reversed-2022 scenario reverses the measured four-point gap, not the literal 71% and 67% turnout levels. It preserves the simulator baseline’s combined Trump/Harris participation and holds within-group vote choices fixed.
